correctness.rationale: The fixed Q has five rational points, dim H0(Q,O(2))=9 and hence 511 nonzero binary sections. An independent non-repository Sympy implementation independently tested all 511 candidates using exact four-affine-chart Groebner Jacobian ideals over F2, finding precisely 240 smooth divisors and point histogram {1:60,2:90,3:60,4:30}. The source enumerates full 120-element automorphism group via the five-point projective frame, with 17 total orbits and five smooth orbits sizes 60,30,60,30,60. The five-point incidence argument gives rank-five evaluation (15 nonzero sections through all five points), all reducible products of two secant plane sections, hence none smooth. Adjunction proves genus one; Hasse bounds rational point counts between one and five. The independently reproduced smoothness census is exhaustive, not mere F2 point sampling.
